SUCCESS: goal entry AND no confirmed geometric overlap AND no footprint outside corridor
SAFETY_FAILURE: confirmed geometric overlap OR footprint outside corridor (existing SE2 arcs, axis extrema checked)
MARGIN_VIOLATION: Separate sum of positive-duration 72Hz intervals with any obstacle swept lower bound <.02m; no change to SUCCESS/SAFETY_FAILURE
label: PHASE5_ABLATION
seed_rule: 101 + 10000*index + 2*request_id; DDPM +1. Same index across six methods.
seed_provenance: Indices9/10 offsets90000/100000 already appear in historical s0_paired_n10_01; not globally unseen seeds. Requested9..16 retained without changes. New Phase5 runs, no Phase4 outcomes reused.
execution_order: index9..16, then methods in the listed order; serial; no retries
rigid_entry: Existing XYPath nearest projection and v2 fixed_entry; v2 >=20mm outgoing/incoming chords and interpolated entry heading (shortest angle). One rigid transform maps entry pose to actual B; no optimization. NumPy-only mirror verified against v2. Invalid chord => recorded rejection and native CURV fallback. Native observation anchor is preserved separately.
graph: Original Phase4c AccelExecution and original Stage2 decision/single serial worker semantics; immediately native RAW, corrected result next eligible controller tick,0.5s stale and superseded unchanged. GRAPH uses original worker/v4 directly; only ablations use subclass with base protocol plus flags. No restarts/tuning.
ablation_details: PREV passes no previous_xy; SDF removes only obstacle inequality rows and obstacle acceptance certificate, retains corridor certificate and definite-side residual; KB removes only boundary-curvature equality and its post-solve tolerance, retains entry-forward inequality. Original initialization guards (including previous v>0) are retained for all. Existing analytic derivatives/scales/bounds unchanged.
safety: All actual obstacle/corridor monitoring and collision termination remain enabled including NO-SDF. Native obstacle clearance remains a diagnostic in NO-SDF and cannot be claimed certified safe.
circling: Literal cumulative absolute wrapped actual yaw change from run start >=2*pi; record total and first threshold-reaching prefix. Existence over any unrestricted contiguous interval is equivalent to total>=2*pi. This may include oscillatory steering and does not prove a spatial loop; no unstated window/threshold.
staleness: At every actual path application (fresh RAW/RIGID or accepted Graph replacement), nearest projected arclength / actual applied path total length, independent of follower progress. Report all and correction-only distributions; no reanchoring.

classification.overall: C1 and C2 => GRAPH_SUPPORTED; C1 only => RIGID_SUFFICIENT_POSSIBLE; otherwise NOT_REPLICATED
classification.technical: Technical failures separate, success counts literal; completeness flagged separately. No technical run is counted as a navigation collision/timeout.

fisher: Two-sided success/non-success among technically valid runs, descriptive only; not used in any decision; paired seed dependence not modeled by Fisher.
plots: Exactly success-count bars plus path overlay for lowest index with technical-PASS CURV failure and GRAPH success. If none, second figure states no qualifying index and draws no substitute paths.
scope: Oracle geometry; SE(2) kinematic Isaac Sim; N8 per method; closed-loop RGB can differ despite paired seed.
preparation: No navigation or NoMaD inference by Codex. Minimal synthetic tests only; freeze before user execution.
git_state: Keep tracked source clean. Existing untracked research/results/phase4_pilot is retained and hashed as in Phase4c.
